summary: The agent failed because it declared success without pytest passing (already documented anti-pattern) and wasted significant time debugging a self-inflicted formula string bug. The trace reveals a specific, reproducible anti-pattern: when building formulas with suffix/prefix variables that already contain delimiters (like `_Current`), f-string concatenation can produce doubled characters (`BaseSal__Current`). This update adds this pattern to the existing excel-workbook-modeling skill's anti-patterns and debugging workflow.
